turns.reply:
I added `frontend(path, directory, *, name=None)` to both `FastAPI` (in `fastapi/applications.py`) and `APIRouter` (in `fastapi/routing.py`). It mounts a `StaticFiles(directory=..., html=True)` app at `path`, so `app.frontend("/", directory="dist")` and `router.frontend(...)` serve a built frontend.

I checked it with a small script: the app serves `index.html` at `/`, and a router-level mount serves `/x/` after `include_router`. The existing static-files tests also pass. I did not add tests, and the issue text is vague, so the hidden tests may expect different details such as an SPA fallback to `index.html` for unknown paths. My implementation does not do that.
